# Kitab al-Tawheed — kitabattawheed.com

> Free audio explanation of Kitab al-Tawheed in two series: a 50-lecture Urdu series (15 classes, ~27 hours) by Fazilat Shaikh Abdullah Nasir Rahmani Hafizahullah, and a 91-duroos Arabic series by Shaikh Salih al-Fawzan Hafizahullah. Stream online or use the Android app for offline listening, Study Mode, and an in-app Book reader.

## Primary content

- Home: https://kitabattawheed.com/
- All Urdu lectures: https://kitabattawheed.com/lectures/
- Arabic series (91 duroos): https://kitabattawheed.com/arabic/
- Search: https://kitabattawheed.com/search/
- Download Android app: https://kitabattawheed.com/download/
- About the series: https://kitabattawheed.com/about/

## Topic guides

- What is Kitab al-Tawheed: https://kitabattawheed.com/kitab-al-tawheed/
- What is Tawheed in Islam: https://kitabattawheed.com/tawheed/
- Sheikh Abdullah Nasir Rahmani: https://kitabattawheed.com/sheikh-rahmani/

## Catalog

- Urdu series: 15 classes (class-01 through class-15), 50 audio parts
- Arabic series: 91 duroos (dars-01 through dars-91)
- Urdu lecture URLs: https://kitabattawheed.com/lectures/{class-id}/{part-slug}/
- Arabic dars URLs: https://kitabattawheed.com/arabic/{dars-slug}/
- RSS feed (Urdu series): https://kitabattawheed.com/feed.xml
- Content metadata: https://al-tawheed-content.pages.dev/tawheed/catalog.json (Urdu), https://al-tawheed-content.pages.dev/tawheed-ar/catalog.json (Arabic)

## App

- Google Play: com.almarfa.tawheed (Kitab al-Tawheed — Al Marfa Duroos)
- Two series (Urdu + Arabic) with a series switcher
- Features: offline downloads, progress tracking, Study Mode (Urdu series), in-app Book reader (Arabic series), background playback, Urdu / Roman Urdu UI

## Contact

See app-config on CDN or the About page for support email.
